'''Caramm V''' was the beautiful fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CV" /> of the [[Talcene sector/Legends|Talcene sector's]] [[Caramm system/Legends|Caramm system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="EA" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel}}
A terrestial world, Caramm V was neutral during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="ROTHC" /> Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} &mdash; According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] take place in [[3638 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "Marauding Negotiations" is part of the ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'' expansion and therefore also takes place in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. In addition, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were fought between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> several prominent [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] on Caramm V were discovered by an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing struggle between the Republic and Sith Empire to be funding [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activities in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] who discovered the data proceeded to blackmail those politicians into ending Caramm V's neutrality.<ref name="ROTHC" />
{{Endgame}}

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict fought between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="CV" /> over three thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="Date" /> the [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictator]] [[Ado Eemon/Legends|Ado Eemon]] subjugated the planet with a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|droid gunships]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] all threats to his rule and ravaging the world in the process.<ref name="CV" /> He allowed the Confederacy to utilize Caramm V's enormous manufacturing facilities during the war and supplied them with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]].<ref name="Ado">{{CSWECite|I|226|Eemon, Ado}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Caramm V was first mentioned in [[Curtis Saxton]]'s [[2005]] [[Book/Legends|reference book]] ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''.<ref name="ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Caramm [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Caramm V, in grid coordinates R-8.<ref name="EA" />
